'''Tideon''' is a [[Water]] type [[DPS]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Bubbit]] at 18 stars, and evolves into [[Haplysia]] at 36 stars after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

==Overview==
Current Description: "Nothing is worse than perfectly styled hair getting ruffled. For Tideon, beauty is armor. This unapproachable elegance is the hardest defense no enemy can breach."

Tideon is a red rarity Tatari.

==Appearance==
A quadruped, blue, orange, and white rabbit-like creature. It has black eyes with long lashes and blue highlights, and it wears a fancy bowtie. It also has an orange tail and long ears with orange circle markings. Additionally, it has markings draped over its body that closely resemble the sea slug [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chromodoris_annae ''Chromodoris annae''].

Tideon's [[Tatari#Glitter_Tataris|Glitter]] form replaces blue with orange, and orange with green.

== Evolution Trial ==
Tideon's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 36 stars. To evolve it into [[Haplysia]] you need to complete the following three tasks:

* Feed this Tatari to B quality.
* Play [[Fishing Contest]] (use x6000 fishing rods) or [[Zobo Shooter]] (use x1,200,000 bullet coins).
* Obtain 60 [[Card Album|cards]] from card packs.

== Trivia ==
* Old Bio: "'...Perhaps migrate the trial to other species, then try [scribbled handwriting]...' -[[NPCs#Dr. C|Dr. C]]'s Log"
* Prior to the update on 3/11/2026, its bio description said: "Tideon has excellent fur, perfect for marketing shampoos. Interested manufacturers should contact the trainer camp."
* Prior to the update on 5/13/2026, its bio description said: "Spending an hour daily on grooming, Tideon leaves no wrinkle unchecked. Emits poisonous cloud mist when angered."
